description: Machine-readable subset of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, for automated compliance checking of retail packages.
authority: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution, Government of India
disclaimer: Advisory only. Verdicts produced by this rule pack are decision support for a Legal Metrology officer, not an adjudication. Always verify against the bare Act and Rules before any enforcement action.

letter_height_table.note: Minimum height of any numeral or letter in a declaration, by area of the principal display panel (PDP).

exemptions.description: Package of net weight 10 g or less, or net volume 10 ml or less, is exempt from the Chapter II declarations.
exemptions.note: Packages above 10 and up to 20 g/ml still require net quantity and retail sale price.

exemptions.description: Fast food items packed by a restaurant or hotel are exempt.
Agricultural farm produce in packages of more than 50 kg is exempt.

rules.title: Name and address of the manufacturer or packer
rules.exposure: Legal Metrology Act 2009, s.36(1); LMPC R.32
rules.remedy: Print the full name and address of the manufacturer, and of the packer where different.

rules.title: Country of origin for imported packages
rules.remedy: Declare the country of origin, manufacture or assembly on an imported package.

rules.title: Common or generic name of the commodity
rules.exposure: Legal Metrology Act 2009, s.36(1); LMPC R.32
rules.remedy: Print the common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package.

rules.title: Net quantity in standard units
rules.exposure: Legal Metrology Act 2009, s.36(1) and s.36(2)
rules.remedy: Declare the net quantity in the standard unit of weight, measure or number.

rules.title: Month and year of manufacture, packing or import
rules.exposure: Legal Metrology Act 2009, s.36(1); LMPC R.32
rules.remedy: Declare the month and year in which the commodity was manufactured, pre-packed or imported.

rules.title: Retail sale price declared
rules.remedy: Declare the retail sale price of the package.

rules.title: Retail sale price stated as inclusive of all taxes
rules.exposure: Legal Metrology Act 2009, s.36(1); LMPC R.32
rules.remedy: State the price as 'Maximum Retail Price Rs. <value> (inclusive of all taxes)'.

rules.title: Retail sale price rounded to the nearest rupee or 50 paise
rules.remedy: Round the retail sale price to the nearest rupee or 50 paise.

rules.title: Consumer care contact details
rules.remedy: Print the name, address and telephone number or e-mail of the person to be contacted for consumer complaints.

rules.title: Net quantity declared without qualifying words
rules.remedy: Remove qualifying expressions. The net quantity must be stated as an exact declared quantity.

rules.title: Correct unit for the declared quantity
rules.remedy: Use grams below 1 kilogram and kilograms at or above; millilitres below 1 litre and litres at or above.

rules.title: No dozen, gross or score notation
rules.remedy: Declare quantity by number in standard units, not in dozens, gross or score.

rules.title: Declarations in Hindi (Devanagari) or English
rules.remedy: Make the mandatory declarations in Hindi in Devanagari script or in English. Other languages may be added.

rules.title: Minimum height of letters and numerals
rules.exposure: Legal Metrology Act 2009, s.36(1); LMPC R.32
rules.remedy: Increase the type size of the declaration to at least the height required for this principal display panel area.

precedence_yields_to.note: For medical device packages the Medical Devices Rules 2017 govern height and width of numerals and letters.

rules.title: Letter width at least one third of its height
rules.remedy: Use a typeface whose character width is at least one third of the character height.
